name: The Shops at Clearfork
summary: The Shops at Clearfork is Fort Worth's premier upscale lifestyle center featuring department stores, boutiques, diverse dining options, and a multiplex cinema. This Simon Property Group destination offers an elegant open-air shopping experience that attracts discerning consumers seeking quality retail and entertainment in a sophisticated setting.
demographics: The Shops at Clearfork attracts an affluent demographic from Fort Worth's western suburbs and nearby communities, with visitors typically representing upper-middle to high-income households earning $100,000+. The primary trade area includes families and professionals aged 30-55 who value upscale shopping experiences and premium dining options. The center draws fashion-conscious shoppers seeking contemporary brands and lifestyle retailers, along with entertainment seekers visiting the multiplex cinema. Given its location in one of Fort Worth's most desirable areas near the Clearfork development, the customer base skews toward educated professionals and established families with significant discretionary spending power.
description: The Shops at Clearfork represents Fort Worth's premier upscale lifestyle destination, seamlessly blending sophisticated retail, exceptional dining, and entertainment in an elegant open-air setting. Managed by Simon Property Group, one of the nation's leading retail real estate companies, this shopping center has established itself as the go-to destination for discerning shoppers in the Fort Worth metropolitan area. The center features an impressive collection of boutiques and department stores that cater to fashion-forward consumers seeking the latest trends and timeless classics. Beyond shopping, visitors can enjoy a diverse array of restaurant options ranging from casual dining to upscale culinary experiences, making it a popular gathering place for both locals and visitors. The addition of a state-of-the-art multiplex cinema enhances the entertainment value, transforming The Shops at Clearfork into a complete lifestyle destination where guests can spend an entire day shopping, dining, and enjoying entertainment. Located at 5188 Monahans Avenue in the thriving Clearfork development area, the center benefits from its proximity to some of Fort Worth's most desirable residential neighborhoods and continues to set the standard for upscale retail experiences in the region.
